candidate.name: 花鬘

currentClientCharacter.y: 花鬘[mán]，古典戏曲《龙凤巾》中的人物，身份为三国时期南蛮王孟获与祝融夫人的女儿，关索夫人之一。在关于关三小姐·关银屏的民间传说中，其名字为“花中秀”，与关索其他几位夫人鲍三娘、王桃、王悦都被关索之姐关银屏编入自己的女兵营中。花鬘并非一般君主家中闺秀，而是与其母祝融相似，是一个可以披甲上阵，善于刀枪作战的女武将。戏曲中在诸葛亮平定南蛮时，花鬘曾与关索作战，失败被俘，两人互生爱意，南蛮王孟获降服后二人成婚。
currentClientCharacter.z: 队友可以适当卖血配合花鬘尽早觉醒
currentClientCharacter.x: 南蛮安稳，####吾辈义不容辞。

candidate.implementationRuleAuthority: Exact current client printed spell links and separately retained linked skills, reconciled with fresh official page/API; do not mix other products or old revisions.
candidate.initialHpInterpretation: API initial_hp=0 with no client af override means no separate initial HP override, not zero starting HP.

interpretationsAndLimits: Souying actual-turn directional history counts true native Use, including true native response Uses; ordinary play-out responses do not count. Empty native response targets are not replaced with a fabricated opponent designation.

Souying claims only exact original-use physical entities still in Processing after the real discard children; incoming cancellation removes only the actual sole designated target. BorrowedSword preserves the full original target pair in the mutation invoice before cancellation.

Zhanyuan runs at actual Preparation, increases maximum HP and recovers before the optional other-living-male choice. Declining the male still performs the printed subsequent Mansi loss; this ordering interpretation is not a separately verified official combination FAQ.

Xili requires another actual-turn source with current Xili and a target without Xili; no source-less placeholder authority. Each participant separately receives native draw children, and paid tails survive subsequent source loss.

Mansi has no printed 64-hand upper limit. Only its exact all-hand Barbarian activation receives the additive open maximum; old all-hand definitions retain their existing contracts. A 65-real-Hand command scenario passed in the root focused runner.

Own discard includes formally usable WoodenOx grain under the same equipped-Ox capability boundary as mature Guolun. It preserves the physical grain source and native discard reason rather than treating grain as Hand.

No server verification or exhaustive combination FAQ is claimed. Source-loss/death, male-decline, conversions and nested combinations are limited by the precise native receipts and the focused scenarios listed below.

The added Souying grain scenario uses real native equipment and storage commands, then consumes the remaining physical Hand through native Slash uses. At payment Hand is empty and the recipient selects the exact stored grain; the equipped Ox honestly remains another legal discard. There is no artificial equipment lock or sole-material claim. The scenario retains cold recovery, exact grain-to-discard bounds, original Slash claim and successful binding once assertions; the root focused runner passed this scenario.

officialSupplement.boundedObservation: Official OL update lists a Mansi/Xiahui conflict fix; it does not supply a complete combination ruling. Mansi materials are a native Use payment, not autonomous discard.

It preserves the parent completion receipt and never writes empty targets into its original selection.
newEventProjection: Seven new facts carry scalar fields and immutable scalar source records; private directional target lists and mutation entity collections are copied into read-only owning records. No public fact exposes a random hidden Hand ID. Existing CharacterSkillsLostEvent uses a read-only skill list.
paymentResumeCorrection: After all actual movement bounds/counter facts are frozen, each synchronous payment producer immediately calls AdvanceRuntimeProgram on its exact owning frame, following mature SpPangTong. This drains native children or completes the terminal instruction before the external damage/card producer can advance again. No observer guard or assertion was weakened.
virtualReturnCorrection: Read-only native producer inspection confirms BeginProgramVirtualCardUse always captures an exact issuer conversion source even with useCardActionWindows:true. The Souying return proof now requires precisely this issuer chain, rather than incorrectly requiring an empty chain. Existing accepted/committed flags, original target, source/hash, history and payment proof remain mandatory.
